snippet.title: Hellxorcist - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free Hellxorcist Demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4600400/HELLXORCIST/

Hellxorcist is a fast-paced, retro-inspired FPS set in a dark gothic world where the line between faith and damnation has been shattered.

For centuries, the secret order of Hellxorcists has stood as the last barrier between humanity and the horrors beyond the gates of Hell. But one day… the gate opens.

Now, you are the last Hellxorcist. 

#boomershooter #indegame #fpsgames #fps #retrogaming
